name: The Siege of Blackford Keep
description: The lord who lost a crown at Blackford Ridge has spent a season turning a toll gate into a real holding. He has no crown to show for it and no plans to stay uncrowned much longer -- and unlike the goblin king, who's already answered for one theft, this one still doesn't know exactly who's been quietly deciding his fate all along.
epilogue: The Uncrowned's second army fared no better than his first. He still doesn't have his crown back. He still doesn't know the guild is the reason why.

name: The Bonewrought Vault
description: Something has been raising the dead again -- not in ones and twos this time, but by the vaultful. Whatever is sealed inside is worth enough to a foot soldier's worth of risen guards to still be defending it centuries later. This isn't a job for one hero. Bring the guild.
epilogue: The vault held, in the end, for whoever the guild actually was. What was raised here goes quiet again -- for now. Whatever forced open a road between the dead and the living to make this happen in the first place is still out there, and it wasn't inconvenienced by any of this.
